alerts.title: Missing FBS/RBS monitoring on DTG
alerts.message: Guidelines require FBS/RBS monitoring (especially adults at risk on DTG) at scheduled visits. The patient is on DTG but no blood glucose testing has been recorded. The clinician's plan does not include any glucose monitoring. While the patient is young (29 years) and no diabetes risk factors are documented, DTG is associated with hyperglycaemia and routine screening is guideline-mandated.

evidence.recommended_action: Order FBS/RBS at this visit and ensure ongoing periodic glucose monitoring per the schedule for patients on DTG.

alerts.title: No LFTs recorded on TDF/3TC/DTG
alerts.message: Guidelines list LFTs as a required laboratory test at scheduled follow-up visits. The patient is on TDF, 3TC, and DTG, all of which can cause hepatotoxicity, yet no liver function tests appear in the recorded labs. The clinician's plan does not include LFT ordering. No hepatic symptoms are reported, but baseline and periodic LFT monitoring is guideline-recommended for patients on this regimen.

evidence.recommended_action: Order LFTs at this visit and ensure periodic hepatic monitoring per guideline schedule for patients on TDF/3TC/DTG.
